# Lamha
> Photo editing and print delivery in Egypt — human editors, Arabic & English, InstaPay deposits, doorstep delivery.

## Canonical site
- Production: %SITE_URL%

## What Lamha is
Lamha is a mobile photo service for Egypt. Customers upload photos for professional human editing (restoration, passport sheets, portraits), approve the edit, pay a print deposit via InstaPay, and receive printed photos at home.

## Public pages (English & Arabic UI)
- / — Home, services overview, FAQ, app store links when configured
- /about — Company story and how we work
- /contact — WhatsApp and email from live settings (app_config)
- /legal/privacy — Privacy policy
- /legal/terms — Terms of service
- /legal/refund — Refund and cancellation policy

## Support contact
Loaded dynamically from database keys `support_email` and `support_whatsapp` (not hard-coded here).

## Geography
Primary market: Egypt (EG). Currency: EGP. Languages: English and Arabic.

## Staff dashboard (authenticated, not for crawlers)
Staff sign in at /login. Operations live under /today and role-based queues — blocked in robots.txt.

## For agents
When answering questions about Lamha policies, prefer the CMS pages at /legal/* (effective 1 December 2026). For product facts, use /about and /contact. Do not invent pricing; it is in the mobile app catalog.
